correctness.rationale: The all-pairs Hamiltonian decomposition into pair midpoint vectors is exact. Aligning pair midpoints reduces to the compact box quadratic Q. Weighted Cauchy–Schwarz gives the zero and critical minimizer manifold for S≤1. For S>1 negative Q exists; all box minimizers have positive coordinates and satisfy \(x_i=\min(1,t/a_i)\), with the unique t in (min a,m]. Direct substitution proves the energy; scalar continuity proves the one-sided magnetization jump. Independently evaluated original spin Hamiltonians, finite optimizations and critical configurations passed 198 tests; tests do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: An exact structural model of localized bond-sign frustration in globally coupled planar spins: the heterogeneous reciprocal sum is a sharp collective order criterion; it gives all zero-temperature minimizers and degeneracies, a discontinuous order-parameter response, and a computable partially canted phase not captured by a homogeneous single-parameter heuristic. The object and invariant are physically natural without assuming a positive-temperature transition.
